subject: Claim Your Free iPhone Now!
body:
Dear valued customer,
Congratulations! You have been selected to receive a brand new iPhone absolutely free. To claim your prize, simply click the link below and provide your shipping address.
http://malicious-link.example.com/claim
This offer is limited, so act fast!
label: phishing

analysis.label: phishing
indicators: free prize claim to create urgency
analysis.explanation: The message uses a classic phishing pattern: it offers a free high‑value item, creates a sense of urgency, and asks the recipient to click a suspicious link and provide personal details, all hallmarks of malicious intent.

subject: Urgent: Your Account Has Been Suspended
body:
Hello,
We have detected unusual activity on your account. To prevent suspension, please verify your identity by clicking the link below and entering your credentials.
http://verify-account.example.com
If you do not verify within 24 hours, your account will be disabled.
Thank you,
Support Team
label: phishing

analysis.label: phishing
analysis.explanation: The email uses urgent, threatening language and a fake support claim to trick the recipient into clicking a malicious link and entering credentials.

subject: Important: Invoice Attached
body:
Hi there,
Please find the invoice attached for your recent purchase. Click here to view the details.
http://invoice-example.com/view?invoice=12345
If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.
Best regards,
Customer Service
label: phishing

analysis.label: phishing
indicators: Unsolicited request to view invoice via link
Generic greeting and lack of specific details
analysis.explanation: The email contains a link to an external domain with no context, uses a generic greeting, and asks the recipient to click to view an invoice, which are common phishing tactics.

subject: Benign: Project Meeting Reminder
body:
Hi Team,
Just wanted to remind you about our project update meeting on Friday at 2pm. Please let me know if you can attend.
Thanks!
-Bob
label: benign

analysis.label: benign
analysis.explanation: The email is a straightforward reminder about a project meeting, contains no requests for personal data, credentials, urgent threats, impersonation, suspicious links, or unusual payment requests.

subject: Benign: Invoice Follow-up
body:
Hi John,
Please find the invoice #1234 attached for your recent purchase. Let me know if you have any questions.
Best regards,
Alice
label: benign

analysis.label: benign
analysis.explanation: The message is a straightforward invoice follow-up with no requests for personal data, credentials, urgent language, impersonation, suspicious links, or unusual payment requests.
